image_description: A light blue, textured fabric bib lying flat on a red patterned background. The bib features a large neck opening with two strap-like extensions at the top corners. The main body is roughly rectangular with rounded bottom corners. It displays a printed graphic of a cartoon character (possibly a bear or dog) next to a white building, and some illegible text above it. There is also a dark horizontal strip near the bottom edge.
